The '''Rules Advocate''' is the [[Players Committee]] advocate for the rules of the game: issuing rulings and errata, maintaining the [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook|Advanced Rulebook]] and the Current Rulings forum thread, and answering questions in the Rules forum. On the current chart the Rules Advocate is also over the Technology team.<ref name="oc2024">PC organization chart PDF (PDF creation date 6 May 2024), [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (Wayback copy of 10 October 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf archived PDF])</ref> The current Rules Advocate is [[Greg Zinn]].

To contact the Players Committee, see the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/contact/ Contact page] on starwarsccg.org.
